title: What SplashLens does
answer: SplashLens is a free-core field reference app for pool service technicians and operators. It brings together pool parts evidence, troubleshooting references, dosing math, notes, stop proof, and shareable summaries when the workflow supports them.
queries: what kind of app is splashlens

title: Who SplashLens is for
answer: Pool service techs, company owners, trainers, facility operators, CPOs, and support teams who need clearer field evidence before deciding what to do next.

title: Free core tools
answer: The core field reference workflow is positioned as free. Some extended online scanner or pro workflows may be offered separately as the product grows.

title: Saved Visit History
answer: It is the SplashLens proof and service-memory layer for a pool stop: readings, photos, model labels, codes, symptoms, notes, prior context, and a human-readable summary when available.

what is a service proof passport

title: Review before sharing
answer: It can support customer-facing explanations, but a human should review the summary, remove anything internal, and make sure the wording matches company policy before sharing.

title: What PartSnap does
answer: PartSnap is a proof and evidence workflow. It can suggest likely part families, visible evidence, missing proof, search terms, and escalation notes.

title: Part fit and ordering limits
answer: No. PartSnap is not a fitment guarantee or warranty approval.
queries: does partsnap guarantee the exact replacement part
does partsnap guarantee the right part

title: What to capture before ordering
answer: Model plate, serial or part markings, wide equipment photo, close-up of the failed part, plumbing context, controller/code photo when relevant, and any measurement or label that would reduce ambiguity.
queries: what should a tech capture before ordering
what photos do i need before ordering
what evidence should i capture before buying a part

title: AI summary availability
answer: No. AI-assisted summaries depend on supported online workflows and connectivity. Treat them as drafts for human review, not final decisions.
queries: can ai summaries work without internet

title: Offline tools
answer: Manual reference tools can work offline after the app has loaded and cached them. Online camera scanning and AI-assisted summaries require internet.
queries: what can i do without internet

title: Route software and CRM
answer: No. Route, billing, dispatch, customer records, and CRM tools run the business. SplashLens is the field reference and field note workflow that helps the stop itself become clearer.

is this a route management app

title: Using SplashLens with route tools
answer: Yes. The conservative workflow is export-first: collect photos and notes, review the summary, then paste, attach, or send the details wherever the company already works.

title: Manufacturer and local rules
answer: No. Local code, facility policy, manufacturer documentation, warranty terms, CPO training, and qualified technician judgment still control.

title: When to escalate field work
answer: Electrical, gas, structural, line-voltage, warranty-sensitive, commercial code, contamination response, and any unsafe or uncertain situation should be escalated to the appropriate qualified person.
